game.label: Your own Dreamcast game image: .cdi, .gdi (keep its track files beside it), .cue with its .bin, or .chd. This recomp needs the USA release, product T-9715N V1.001.

exit_codes.2: It couldn't read that game image. Use your own Dreamcast copy as .cdi, .gdi (with its track files beside it), .cue (with its .bin) or .chd.
exit_codes.3: That's a different release or revision. This recomp needs the USA Dreamcast release, product T-9715N V1.001.

settings.label: Window mode
settings.help: Fullscreen fills your screen. Windowed is handy while setting things up; Alt+Enter switches at any time.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: Draws the game at a multiple of 640×480. Higher is sharper and needs a faster graphics card.

settings.label: Aspect ratio
settings.help: Expanded widens the view to fill a widescreen. Original keeps the console's 4:3 picture with bars.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: The game runs at 60. Auto blends an extra frame on a 120 Hz or faster screen; 120 always does; 60 shows only the game's frames.

settings.label: Frame timing
settings.help: Match display runs at your screen's rate when it is within 0.5% of the Dreamcast's 59.94 Hz. Exact keeps the console's timing.

settings.label: HUD layout
settings.help: Where the HUD sits on a widened picture. Original keeps it in the 4:3 area; Expanded anchors it to the screen edges.

settings.label: Controller mode
settings.help: Classic keeps the Dreamcast's controls. Modern adds right-stick camera, RT fire, LT aim and left-stick strafing with RB.

settings.label: Mouse camera
settings.help: Horizontal only turns left and right. Full camera also lets you look up and down.

settings.label: Loud sounds
settings.help: Original is the console's mix, which clips on the loudest hits. Softened rounds those peaks off.

actions.label: Saves and settings
actions.help: Your memory card and the game's settings file.
